lyricsEditor.aiGenerationDescription: AI will generate lyrics matching your theme and syllable count.
lyricsEditor.additionalRequestPlaceholder: e.g., More emotional, include specific words, emphasize rhythm, etc.
lyricsEditor.lyricsCreationDescription: Generate lyrics with AI for each line or edit directly.
lyricsEditor.syllableAdjustmentDescription: Divide the analyzed syllable count by line. You can generate more accurate lyrics for each line's syllable count.
lyricsEditor.lineStructureDescription: Refer to the analyzed syllable count ({count} syllables) and divide by line. Total syllables may vary based on syncopation or compositional intent.
lyricsEditor.tip1: The default syllable count is for reference; adjust freely according to compositional intent
lyricsEditor.tip2: If there's syncopation, you can move syllables to adjacent lines
lyricsEditor.tip3: More syllables for fast melodies, fewer for slow parts
lyricsEditor.tip4: Allow more room for emotionally important parts
lyricsEditor.lyricsEditDescription: Review generated lyrics and make edits as needed.
lyricsEditor.editTip1: Replace long words with shorter ones (e.g., "beautiful" → "nice")
lyricsEditor.editTip2: Adjust particles to control syllable count
lyricsEditor.editTip3: Use repetitions or exclamations: "oh", "yeah", "la la la", etc.
lyricsEditor.editTip4: Match the rhythm at line endings for natural flow
lyricsEditor.generationError: An error occurred while generating lyrics. Please try again.
